title: Whitechapel Hits The Studio Next Week
author: Dakota G.
contentHtml:
Whitechapel is hitting the studio next week, which is no surprise due to the fact that they are putting out their sixth full length album this year. Guitarist Zach Householder posted on Instagram not to long ago a picture of the beloved blade with the caption “So with a new year comes all new things. Drum tracking for the next @whitechapelband album starts next week which is crazy to think about because it's our 6th full length album. Thanks to everyone (bands and fans alike) for all the support and good times this past year. Here's to many more and cheers to all of our armed forces bringing in the new year away from home. 🍻🍻🍻 Everyone be safe tonight and don't be a freakin' moron. Call uber, lift, or designate a DD. To any of my friends at home reading this, call me if you need a ride. #happynewyears#designateadriver”
This should come to big surprise to anyone as it was almost two years ago when they put out their fifth full length album “Our Endless War” which received a lot of mixed reviews from the fans, leaving a lot of things to our imagination for this new album.
Stay posted here on Metal Lifestyle for all things metal, and more news about the album as it comes out.

​- Dakota G. ​
